claim_summaries.claim: Every nonnegative multiaffine even-support right-half-plane-stable polynomial satisfies the all-size coefficient-one square-root symmetric-exchange inequality, including shared cores and zero coefficients.
claim_summaries.status: proved by complete derivation in INITIAL.txt

claim_summaries.claim: The coefficient-one constant is sharp for every even difference size in a fixed-pair product family, also realized by hard-BCS matrices with one directed entry per pair.
claim_summaries.status: proved algebraically; bounded exact fixture executed

claim_summaries.claim: In full exchange support, equality is equivalent to the balanced odd-degree slice having one negative real root and all remaining roots purely imaginary.
A complete equality decomposition for one-sided zero patterns is not established; an exact limiting endpoint-ratio criterion is recorded.
